reason: A macOS-only dsh web plugin adds a session-header control that opens the current session workspace in Finder via the host open command.

summaries.zh: 这是一个适用于 macOS 的 dsh web 插件，可在会话标题栏中添加按钮，一键在 Finder 中打开当前会话的工作目录。
summaries.en: A macOS dsh web plugin that adds a session-header button for opening the current session workspace in Finder.

capabilities: Adds a session-header button in the web interface
Resolves the current session's workspace path
Calls a host endpoint that executes the macOS open command to launch Finder
